title: 第二章 杀神第三章 主为奴第四章 博彩 上
content_zh:
阡陌之中，陆宁慢慢的踱步，正即将秋收，黍米准备入库，田间地头绿油油金黄黄一块一块的庄稼地，这里是县郊，都是比较好的田地，以稻田居多。
东海是平原之地，河流也多，一眼望去，风吹草低，秋高气爽之时，远方碧空白云，一条银带蜿蜒贯入南湖。
东海县城，以前曾经被称为郁州，县城南有东海山，临海处是天然良港，从扬州去日韩的商船，偶尔会在这里停泊补给。
刚才陆宁本来想去刘府转一圈，但到了刘府外面，就听里面哭嚎震天，正是抄家进行时，鸡飞狗跳。
陆宁不太想看这等凄惨画面，好像自己多欺负人一样。所以辞别乔舍人，说来县郊刘家的田庄转转。
刘志才在此经营多年，是本县第一豪强，就说田地，县郊近邻明湖的上好良田，刘家就有上千亩。
东海县开府筑城极早，要追涉到汉代，整个海州，人口十几万，东海县就有数万，在现在这个年代，人口算是稠密了。
而本县最好的良田便是环绕明湖的这一片了，有水源，好灌溉，自为良田，只是这些良田，这些年都被刘家兼并，在明湖之畔，刘志才更大兴土木修了别苑，不过现今别苑中，自然也是愁云惨雾，陆宁便没过去，只是远远的在田陌中踱步。
一阵轻风吹来。
陆宁伸了个懒腰，看来穿越后遗症没有了，这怕风怕冷的感应已经没了。
不过，唐主赏赐下的狐裘，自己以后一些场合还是要穿，好似金陵有权贵人物召见过自己，自己这病怏怏的形象，还是要维持。
乱世，低调为好，低调为好。
先观察观察这个世界，再做打算。
正思忖间，却听身后脚步声响，有人呼唤：“大郎？”
陆宁回头，却见土丘后匆匆走来两个人，走在前面的尖嘴猴腮汉子，是明湖村村正尤老三，喊陆宁的，是一个憨厚的汉子，也是明湖村的佃户，小名阿牛，平素对陆宁甚是亲厚，是陆宁为数不多的朋友之一。
这个明湖村，住的都是刘家庄园的佃农，有三四十户人家，聚居在一起，成为村落。
尤老三就是其中一家佃户，不过他有个胞妹生得极为美貌被刘志才相中纳为妾侍，尤老三鸡犬升天，被举为佃户村落的村正，主要便是帮刘家收租。
陆家破落，也不得不佃刘家田地来种，所以陆宁和尤老三倒也打过几次交道。
陆宁琢磨着也苦笑，正是因为破落户不多见，自己也算属于特殊人物，经常被其他佃农背后指指点点，也就比较惹眼，不然尤老三未必认识自己。
见到陆宁转身，自己没认错人，阿牛走上两步，有些急切的说：“大郎，听说你归农，我早想去看你，但一直不得空……是了，秋收后我家里有了些米粮，你先拿去给刘婆，暂时缓上一缓？”

陆宁心里一怔，更暖暖的，实则阿牛去了租子，剩下的米粮能维系一家五口的口粮就不错了，阿牛早婚，有一子二女，其妻王氏精明强悍，是有名的母老虎，阿牛把家里口粮匀给自己去还债，那王氏还不吃了他？
陆宁还没说话，尤老三已经不耐烦的道：“现今什么当口了？还在此不着边际的胡言乱语，陆大，你快些走，不要在这里碍事！”他脸色很不好看，有些惶急之色。
陆宁知道，刘志才垮台，尤老三现今自也如丧家犬，只是不知道为什么说自己碍事，很是有些莫名其妙。
又见阿牛不敢多说什么，只是一个劲儿给自己使眼色。
“啊，来了来了！”尤老三喊了声。
却见沟壑另一边，两旁野草丛生的阡陌小路中，有个人影正向这边移动，尤老三便快步跑，迎了上去，阿牛对陆宁使个眼色，“大郎，你先回！”他也跟了上去。
陆宁却是正闲得无聊，便也不紧不慢的跟在了后面。
对这个世界，他很好奇，还在探索中。
今生的记忆，有些比较模糊，可能是因为今生的自己，有时候痴痴呆呆的吧。
来人却是个妇人，连滚带爬的和尤老三在田间沟壑中汇合，她便哀哭起来，“三哥，我好命苦啊？！”凄凄惨惨的哭个不停，声音却是异常娇媚动听，哭音更颇有些勾魂夺魄。
陆宁站在沟壕上，不由哑然失笑，那妇人手中拎着一个硕大的包裹，下沟壑时摔了一跤，包裹摔得松散，露出里面好大一块“金锭”，当然，现今所谓金锭，实则是黄铜，但看起来，怕也有二三十斤，真亏这妇人是怎么背着跑过来的。
这妇人，不消说，自然是刘志才的小妾尤五娘了，刘志才遭难，她这是要夹带私逃，从别苑里偷出这般重的“宝物”。
陆宁以前没见过尤五娘，但这个you物的艳名却是如雷贯耳了。
平素佃农们在田间劳作，吹牛打屁时，说些荤素笑话又借以讽刺收租甚重的“刘扒皮”，他们不敢用威仪无比的正室夫人甘氏，倒是这尤五娘倒霉，时常成为佃农们YY的对象。
在那些荤素笑话中，陆宁印象最深的便是一则，说尤五娘腰肢太细太软，刘明府便是试也不敢试，怕折了这位美娇娘的腰；又说刘明府鰥居了数年，这两年突然娶妻纳妾成瘾，其实是老而无用，刻意掩饰而已，那尤五娘耐不住寂寞，早已红杏出墙。
不过此时看着沟壑中，灰头土脑满身泥土的这妇人，陆宁不觉好笑，真不知道看起来纤弱无比的她，是怎么将这铜块偷出来的，真是人为财死鸟为食亡啊，古人诚不欺我！
content_en:
Among the streets, Lu Ning paced slowly. The autumn harvest was about to be harvested. The millet was ready to be stored in the warehouse. There were green and golden crop fields in the fields. This was the outskirts of the county. They were all relatively good fields, mostly rice fields.
The East China Sea is a land of plains with many rivers. At a glance, the wind blows and the grass is low. When the autumn air is high and the air is crisp, there are blue and white clouds in the distance, and a silver belt winds through the South Lake.
Donghai County, formerly known as Yuzhou, has Donghai Mountain in the south of the county and a natural harbor near the sea. Merchant ships from Yangzhou to Japan and South Korea occasionally dock here for supplies.
Just now, Lu Ning wanted to go around the Liu Mansion, but when she got outside the Liu Mansion, she heard loud cries and howls inside. It was the time when the house was being ransacked, and everything was going crazy.
Lu Ning didn't want to see such miserable scenes, as if he was bullying others. So I bid farewell to the people of Qiaoshe and came to visit the Liu family's farm on the outskirts of the county.
Liu Zhicai has been operating here for many years and is the most powerful person in the county. As for the land, the Liu family owns thousands of acres of good farmland near Minghu Lake on the outskirts of the county.
Donghai County was founded very early, dating back to the Han Dynasty. The entire Haizhou had a population of hundreds of thousands, and Donghai County had tens of thousands. In this era, the population is considered dense.
The best farmland in the county is the area surrounding Minghu Lake. It has water sources and is easy to irrigate. It is considered fertile farmland. However, these farmlands have been annexed by the Liu family in recent years. On the bank of Minghu Lake, Liu Zhicai has built a garden beside Minghu Lake. However, nowadays, the garden is naturally miserable. Lu Ning did not go there, but walked among the fields from a distance.
A light breeze blew.
Lu Ning stretched. It seemed that the aftereffects of time travel were gone. The feeling of being afraid of wind and cold was gone.
However, the fox fur gifted by the Lord of Tang Dynasty will still be worn on some occasions in the future, as if he has been summoned by powerful people in Jinling, he still has to maintain his sickly image.
In troubled times, it is better to be low-key and low-key.
Observe the world first and then make plans.
While I was thinking about it, I heard the sound of footsteps behind me, and someone called: "Da Lang?"
Lu Ning turned around and saw two people walking hurriedly from behind the mound. The man with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks walking in front was You Laosan, the mayor of Minghu Village. The one named Lu Ning was a simple and honest man who was also a tenant of Minghu Village. His nickname was A Niu. He had always been very affectionate to Lu Ning and was one of Lu Ning's few friends.
In this Minghu Village, all tenant farmers of the Liu Family Manor live. There are thirty or forty families living together to form a village.
You Laosan was one of the tenants, but he had a sister who was extremely beautiful and was chosen as a concubine by Liu Zhicai. You Laosan's chickens and dogs ascended to heaven and was promoted to the village leader of the tenant village, mainly helping the Liu family collect rent.
The Lu family was in ruins and had to rent the Liu family's land for farming, so Lu Ning and You Laosan had to deal with each other several times.
Lu Ning thought about it and smiled bitterly. It was precisely because it was rare to see poor households and he was considered a special person. He was often pointed out by other tenant farmers behind his back, so he was more conspicuous, otherwise You Laosan might not know him.
Seeing Lu Ning turn around, A Niu took two steps forward and said with some urgency: "Da Lang, I heard that you have returned to farming. I have wanted to see you for a long time, but I have never been able to get around to it... Yes, I have some rice at home after the autumn harvest. Can you give it to Granny Liu first to give it a break?"
Lu Ning was startled and felt even warmer. In fact, A Niu had gone to rent a house. The remaining rice grains could sustain a family of five, which is good. A Niu married early and had a son and two daughters. His wife, Wang, was smart and strong, and was a famous tigress. A Niu shared the family rations with himself to pay off his debts, so why wouldn't Wang eat him?
Before Lu Ning could speak, You Laosan said impatiently: "What are you talking about now? You are still talking nonsense here. Lu Da, please go quickly and don't get in the way here!" His face was very ugly, and he looked a little anxious.
Lu Ning knew that Liu Zhicai had collapsed and You Laosan was now like a lost dog, but he didn't know why he said he was in the way., which is quite baffling.
I saw that A Niu didn't dare to say anything, and just kept winking at himself.
"Ah, it's coming, it's coming!" You Laosan shouted.
But on the other side of the ravine, on the grassy path on both sides, there was a figure moving towards this side. You Laosan ran quickly to meet him. A Niu winked at Lu Ning, "Da Lang, you go back first!" He also followed.
Lu Ning, however, was bored and followed him leisurely.
He is very curious about this world and is still exploring it.
The memories of this life are somewhat vague, maybe because I am sometimes in a daze in this life.
The person who came was a woman. She rolled around and met You Laosan in a field ravine. She began to cry, "Third brother, my life is so miserable?!" She kept crying miserably, but her voice was extremely charming and sweet, and her cry was even more soul-stirring.
Lu Ning stood on the ditch and couldn't help but laugh. The woman was holding a huge package in her hand. She fell down when she went down the ravine. The package fell loose, revealing a large "gold ingot" inside. Of course, the so-called gold ingot nowadays is actually brass, but it looks like it weighs twenty or thirty kilograms. It's a shame how the woman came here carrying it on her back.
Needless to say, this woman was Liu Zhicai's concubine You Wuniang. Liu Zhicai was in trouble. She wanted to escape with Liu Zhicai and steal such a heavy "treasure" from the other garden.
Lu Ning had never met You Wuniang before, but the beauty's reputation was well known to her.
The tenant farmers usually worked in the fields, and when they were bragging and spanking, they would tell some meaty and vegetarian jokes and ridicule "Liu Papi" who collected heavy rents. They did not dare to use the words of the majestic wife Gan, but it was You Wuniang who was unlucky and often became the target of sexual intercourse by the tenant farmers.
Among those erotic jokes, the one that impressed Lu Ning the most was one, saying that You Wuniang's waist was too thin and too soft, and Liu Ming's house didn't dare to try it, for fear of breaking this beautiful lady's waist. It was also said that Liu Ming's house had been a widower for several years, and in the past two years, he suddenly became addicted to marrying and keeping concubines. In fact, he was old and useless, and deliberately concealed it. You Wuniang couldn't bear the loneliness, and had already cheated on her.
However, Lu Ning couldn't help but laugh when he looked at this woman in the ravine, gray-headed and covered in dirt. He really didn't know how she, who looked so fragile, managed to steal this copper piece. It's true that people die for money and birds die for food. The ancients did not deceive me!
